dict.string: Hourly openclaw_cli_backend_drift walker. Cadence 3600s = 1h. Verifies every cli-backend-*.js under /opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/ contains BOTH `--fallback-model` and `claude-opus-4-8`. Guards the 2026-08-31 monkey-patch (fallback-pin) against Homebrew/npm upgrade drift — dist files are hash-named so an upgrade can drop a new filename that never sees the patch. RunAtLoad TRUE so first load produces a baseline row immediately; StartInterval then reruns hourly. Wrapper timeout belt = 60s (Perl SIGALRM) — filesystem scan should be sub-second; 60s covers a wedged NFS/APFS edge case.
